title: Matariki Origin
description: Adds the Matariki Origin by Redwood to your minecraft world!
body:
[Matariki Origin Video Demonstration](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lbIIWF6qtK0) ## Matariki Rising across the night sky, your children present omens for the year to come. **Align**
You are aligned with a daughter star of Matariki. Every night your alignment switches to the next star. - Waitī and Waitā
The twins Waitī and Waitā have been entrusted with looking after the smallest and fastest creatures of the world; their alignment grants you both small stature and the ability to phase through soil-like blocks._ - Waipunarangi
Waipunarangi's duty is to the waters of the world - the oceans, lakes and rivers; her alignment allows you to breath and move underwater as if you were on land. - Tupu-ā-nuku
Tupu-ā-nuku pays special attention to making sure plants have everything they need to grow strong; her alignment causes nature around you to flourish. - Tupu-ā-rangi
Tupu-ā-rangi cares for the animals and plants that live above the ground; her alignment ensures no creature above the ground can harm you. (You are immune to mob damage while you can see the sky) - Ururangi
Ururangi races like the winds across the sky, and the weather and sky fall under her domain; her alignment grants you limited flight. (You can fly up to 5 blocks above the ground) **Heavens Born**
Your skin is a transparent and you are slightly taller. **Night's Procession**
You cannot sleep, although you can set your spawnpoint.
